content_fields.title: Monitor containers in real-time
content_fields.description: Monitor running containers for anomalous behaviour in real time.
content_fields.guidance: Runtime monitoring should observe process execution, network connections and file writes inside containers, alerting on behaviour that departs from the expected profile such as a shell spawning inside an application container.
content_fields.found: No runtime security agent, log shipping or alerting is configured for the containers.
content_fields.missing: A runtime monitoring agent, its deployment and an alert destination.
content_fields.conclusion: Runtime container monitoring is a security platform capability deployed alongside the workload, not code in this repository.
content_fields.action: The security operations team should deploy runtime monitoring to the container hosts.
